$Comment: The game's own elites, by exact role id: the elite skeleton in both its phases, the burnt praetorians, the pirate captains, the Shadow Knight, the two larger Aberrant zombies, the Void Spawn and the young dungeon broodmother. ZigRank Elite counts each one as an elite for CommonLib's crowd-control rule and for every boss-or-elite check, and Zig_Boss_Or_Elite includes this group, so no foe family counts them. A mod opts its own elite in the same way from its own pack: an NPC group of its own listing its roles, tagged ZigRank Elite. Add a game role here by shipping a file with this same id.
